projectDescription: A free web app for running private soccer prediction pools with real-time auto-scoring, live leaderboards, and smart notifications — built for friend groups, offices, and communities.
keyFeatures: Private picks — no one sees picks until the match deadline locks
Real-time auto-scoring — leaderboard updates seconds after final whistle
5 scoring modes: Casual, Classic, Escalating, Cascading Bracket, and Custom
Full elimination bracket with auto-advancing teams
Smart push notifications for pick deadlines and leaderboard changes
Invite via shareable link or join code — no account required to join
PWA installable — works on any device, no app store needed
Custom pool branding with logo and colors (Pro/Enterprise)
publicApiSurface: createPool(data) — create a new prediction pool
joinPool(poolId) — join a pool by ID
joinPoolByCode(code) — join a pool via 8-character invite code
lookupPoolByCode(code) — resolve a join code to a pool slug
submitPrediction / updatePrediction — submit or update a match pick before deadline
Pool scoring presets: casual, escalating, cascading-bracket
Scoring rules: exact-score, correct-outcome, correct-margin, total-goals, clean-sheet, close-score
Push notification subscription (Web Push API / VAPID)
Pool tiers: free (up to 25 members), pro (50–1000 members), enterprise (1000+)
Auth: Google OAuth, Facebook OAuth, email/password
